timings.limits: Incremental LLVM and frontend builds; not a cold LLVM build. Module stage observations are single correctness-suite cases. Program smoke latency is not representative application runtime throughput.
timings.memory_scope: Maximum individual descendant RSS for benchmark commands; not aggregate tree memory.

hard_cutover.runtime_integration: native libobjc2 plus explicit independent service library

native_milestone.scope: Explicit Objective-C++ ARC Optional/Result local copy/move construction for direct strong/weak/unsafe object leaves and strong Blocks, extending direct construction and strong object/Block try? initialization.
native_milestone.semantics: Source glvalues are evaluated once; only active arms initialize. Copies preserve the source; mutable strong/weak moves clear its payload while preserving its tag. Const strong moves copy. Native ARC registers destruction and unwinding cleanup.
native_milestone.evidence: IR and PCH round trips; O0/O2 exact object destruction, weak zeroing, nil/none, both Result arms, captured Blocks, templates, failed source evaluation, typed-error optionalization, defer and native exceptions; installed compiler consumers and live clangd navigation/hover/completion.
native_milestone.limits: Explicit local construction only; implicit managed copying, assignment, by-value returns, nested managed carriers, managed MRC transfer and weak/unsafe Blocks remain unsupported.
native_milestone.public_status: defer qualified; Optional/Result and synchronous throws remain reserved pending complete public-language qualification.

installed_module_milestone.scope: Source-built MRC provider, derived ARC interface and managed consumer; content-verified compilation reuse, always-linked executable and v2 dependency records.
installed_module_milestone.acceptance: 14 O0/O2 builds and six rejected imports on the qualified SDK and each fresh ordinary-user distribution; private body/header, API and damaged artifact cases; spaces and quotes in source paths.
installed_module_milestone.limits: Bounded installed example graph; general multi-package resolution and public module syntax remain future work.
